title: Agent Autonomy Extensions Master Roadmap
goal: Extend the completed agent capability foundation into production-grade Telegram-driven research, browser understanding, no-GPU observation, sandbox execution and Memory/RaptorGraph knowledge commits.

hard_constraints.sensitive_content_policy: DSGVO gate decides local-only versus API-capable processing

target_user_stories.request: analysiere die asv bw hilfeseite vollstaendig und fasse alle informationen im gedaechtnis zusammen
target_user_stories.expected_result: Odysseus asks only for missing bounded inputs if needed, crawls the approved ASV BW scope, extracts structured knowledge, writes reviewed abstractions into Memory/RaptorGraph and reports source-linked gaps.

target_user_stories.request: pruefe homepage x und y, erklaere die Unterschiede und merke dir die relevanten Prozesse
target_user_stories.expected_result: Odysseus compares bounded sites with browser evidence, console/network summaries and source-linked memory candidates.

target_user_stories.request: fuehre diesen kleinen Code-Test in einer Sandbox aus und zeig mir das Ergebnis
target_user_stories.expected_result: Odysseus runs bounded code in an isolated Podman sandbox, captures artifacts, screenshots/logs where applicable and returns a concise operator summary.

capability_lanes.name: Telegram Task Orchestrator
capability_lanes.done_when: Telegram can start, pause, query and receive status for long-running bounded agent tasks without requiring the user to babysit the run.

capability_lanes.name: Complete Website Research Pipeline
capability_lanes.done_when: Odysseus can analyze an approved site scope fully enough for operator intent, with crawl caps, deduplication, source map, gaps and redacted synthesis.

capability_lanes.name: Browser DevTools Understanding
capability_lanes.done_when: Agents can understand page behavior through console, network, DOM, accessibility tree, storage metadata and failed requests without exposing secrets.

capability_lanes.name: No-GPU Visual Observer
capability_lanes.done_when: Odysseus can visually observe pages/apps through software-rendered screenshots, frame sampling and diff evidence without a GPU.

capability_lanes.name: Sandbox Code Execution
capability_lanes.done_when: Agents can run bounded code/tests/builds in disposable Podman sandboxes with scoped mounts, resource limits and redacted artifacts.

capability_lanes.name: Memory And RaptorGraph Knowledge Commit
capability_lanes.done_when: Website and sandbox findings become source-linked Memory/RaptorGraph candidates, then policy-approved knowledge entries with model stamps and provenance.

execution_order: AAE-1 Telegram task lifecycle and status model
AAE-2 bounded website crawler planner and source inventory
AAE-6 memory candidate schema and write policy
AAE-3 browser evidence enrichment with DevTools-style signals
AAE-4 software-rendered visual observer and frame/diff budget
AAE-5 sandbox job templates and artifact observer
AAE-2 plus AAE-6 ASV BW pilot under explicit live web and memory gates

global_gate_queue.decision_needed: Approve target domain, crawl depth, page cap, rate limit and robots/login handling.
global_gate_queue.risk_if_bypassed: Unbounded crawling or accidental access to unrelated/private pages.

global_gate_queue.decision_needed: Decide when research abstractions may auto-write versus require review.
global_gate_queue.risk_if_bypassed: Low-quality or stale statements could become long-term truth.

global_gate_queue.decision_needed: Allow disposable Podman sandbox jobs with configured resource limits and mounts.
global_gate_queue.risk_if_bypassed: Code may execute outside the intended isolation model.

global_gate_queue.decision_needed: UI agent decides placement and interaction model for long-running tasks and memory review.
global_gate_queue.risk_if_bypassed: Backend can work but operator experience remains incomplete.

non_goals: No persistence of raw private documents or raw private page captures.
No UI implementation in this roadmap set.
success_metrics: Telegram can start an ASV BW research-to-memory task with bounded parameters.
Research output includes source map, topic map, confidence, gaps and timestamps.
Browser evidence includes DOM, accessibility, screenshot, console and network summaries.
No-GPU visual observer produces usable screenshots and diffs through software rendering.
Sandbox jobs produce redacted artifacts and exit summaries under resource limits.
Memory and RaptorGraph entries are clickable internally, source-linked and model-stamped.
